answer_1.quote: Our main goal is to quantify the predictive power of different SLRs by combining them with a pretrained language model and measuring how this affects next-token generation performance.
answer_1.outputs: The generated outputs are next-word predictions in an incremental language modeling setup, conditioned on linguistic graph structures.
